einzeiler: Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian on tech, family, and investments in pets and sports.
kurzfassung: Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian discusses his journey from leaving law school to build Reddit, his venture firm Seven Seven Six, and investing in women's sports and pet travel. He reflects on partnering with his wife, tennis legend Serena Williams, raising their daughters, and building a family farm. Ohanian also shares his outlook on AI, authenticity, and the future of technology.
stichpunkte: Alexis Ohanian skipped the LSAT after stopping at a Waffle House and decided to co-found Reddit instead of practicing law.
He sold Reddit to Condé Nast in 2006 for 10 million dollars and later returned as executive chairman in 2014 to lead a major turnaround.
Ohanian publicly resigned from Reddit's board in 2020 in protest over harmful content, prompting the company to implement stricter policies.
Through his venture firm Seven Seven Six, he invests in high-growth companies including Anthropic, Mister Beast, and Retrieve Air.
He co-founded Angel City Football Club, contributing significantly to the rapid growth and commercial expansion of women's professional sports.
Ohanian and his wife, Serena Williams, live in Florida where they are raising two daughters and managing a family farm with chickens and gardens.
He views AI as a transformative tool that will eventually lower the costs of foundational needs like healthcare, food, and education.
Outside of tech and investing, Ohanian is an avid weekend chef who regularly cooks for his family and experiments with baking and smoked meats.
